texts: good. 'chief Keeper' is fused into a role title that still counts as a kind of Keeper, and Meren Tallowhand is typed with it.
good. the tending, Meren Tallowhand as the tender, the station itself and its link to the named Cliff Path all come through, with no invented relation between them.
good. the marriage is recorded once and tagged symmetric, so it answers from either spouse, and both multi-word names stay whole.
good. plain typing of a named individual, nothing lost.
